method: Pollen CADR saturates in the certified data: many models report the same top value, so ranking by it would pick an arbitrary subset. We kept every zero-ozone ENERGY STAR air purifier at that top pollen CADR (450 cfm or more) and ranked those with the highest dust CADR, weighing dust CADR most and the five-year electricity cost the rest (running cost differs far more between models than dust CADR does, so a heavier cost weight would let running cost, not dust CADR, decide the order) (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5).
name: Best air purifiers for allergies: top certified pollen CADR, ranked by dust CADR and running cost
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100

excluded.why: conservative choice: only units that report 0 ppb ozone in certification; UL's zero-ozone test (UL 2998) cannot quantify low readings, so this also drops units whose small non-zero reports are not reliably different from 0

selection.label: Dust CADR
selection.merge: listings with identical certified values on all 23 reported fields
